transcript.text: Could you make a clip of a fictional woman standing in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera? I like the idea of a garden scene because it reminds me of the little shared garden near where I used to live. To explain the format in the middle of all this, it should be a silent 7-second widescreen clip. The wording should be “Maya Chen” on the first line with “Community Gardener” underneath, at the bottom left from second 1 through the end. Please use white lettering on a dark backing, keep it off her face, and include no other text.

Your garden clip is done. Download it here:
http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/556cd8e7b16a4a0683d1fd8561c73cd2.mp4

(Direct Magic Hour copy, link valid about 24 h: https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbi42qv051uh4018tg2uuwz/output.mp4?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T023115Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-)

What I checked:
- Widescreen 16:9 (858×480, the free-plan 480p): yes
- Length: 7.3 s, so a little over your 7 s
- Silent: yes, no audio track
- Cost: 168 credits

What I couldn't check: your free plan has no tool for placing exact text on a video, so the video model (minimax-h3) drew the name lower-third itself. I asked for "Maya Chen" above "Community Gardener" at the bottom left, white text on a dark box, away from her face, from second 1 to the end, with no other text. I haven't been able to watch the clip, so please check that:
- both lines are spelled right
- the title shows up around second 1
- it stays clear of her face

If the text came out wrong, I can redo it in one of two ways:
- Bake the title into a starting picture. The words are exact, but they're on screen from second 0, not second 1.
- Put the name on its own title card right after the scene. The words are exact, but they're not over the garden shot.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a download link to the 7.3 s, 16:9, silent garden clip, plus a list of checks and cost. The caveats (unverified on-screen text, length slightly over 7 s) and the offered redo options do not change the main outcome, which is a delivered clip.
